mapper.sql: withdrawal_id, enrollment_id, reason, requested_at, status, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_note, approved_refund_amount, refund_amount, refund_method, refund_voucher, refunded_by, refunded_at

SELECT w.withdrawal_id, w.enrollment_id, e.student_user_id, su.real_name AS student_name, su.phone, e.license_type, e.status AS enrollment_status, e.paid_amount, w.reason, w.requested_at, w.status, w.reviewed_by, ru.real_name AS reviewed_by_name, w.reviewed_at, w.review_note, w.approved_refund_amount, w.refund_amount, w.refund_method, w.refund_voucher, w.refunded_at FROM withdrawal_request w JOIN enrollment e ON e.enrollment_id = w.enrollment_id JOIN user_account su ON su.user_id = e.student_user_id LEFT JOIN user_account ru ON ru.user_id = w.reviewed_by
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withdrawal_request w JOIN enrollment e ON e.enrollment_id = w.enrollment_id WHERE e.student_user_id = #{studentUserId} AND w.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'APPROVED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO withdrawal_request (enrollment_id, reason, requested_at, status) VALUES (#{enrollmentId}, #{reason}, NOW(), 'SUBMITTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE withdrawal_request SET reason = #{reason}, requested_at = NOW(), status = 'SUBMITTED', reviewed_by = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, review_note = NULL, approved_refund_amount = NULL WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} AND status = 'REJECTED'

UPDATE withdrawal_request SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = NOW(), review_note = #{reviewNote}, approved_refund_amount = #{approvedRefundAmount} WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE withdrawal_request SET refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, refund_method = #{refundMethod}, refund_voucher = #{refundVoucher}, refunded_by = #{refundedBy}, refunded_at = NOW(), status = 'REFUNDED' WHERE withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND #{refundAmount} = approved_refund_amount
